tests.name: test_int64_float_equality_near_max
tests.intent: Probes equality between large signed integers and floats near 2^63 where widening was previously lossy.

tests.name: test_int64_float_ordering_transitivity
tests.intent: Probes transitivity of strict weak ordering relations between large signed integers and floating-point numbers.

tests.name: test_unsigned_int_float_boundary
tests.intent: Probes comparisons between large unsigned integers and floats near 2^63 and 2^64 boundaries.

tests.name: test_nan_mixed_comparison
tests.intent: Probes behavior of NaN operands when compared against signed and unsigned integers.

tests.name: test_exact_integer_representation
tests.intent: Probes standard exact comparisons for small integers and their float equivalents.

tests.name: test_fractional_float_comparison
tests.intent: Probes comparisons involving integers and floats with fractional components within valid ranges.

tests.name: test_spaceship_operator_mixed
tests.intent: Probes C++20 three-way comparison operator between integers and floats.

tests.name: test_extreme_float_magnitudes
tests.intent: Probes mixed comparisons when float magnitudes are vastly larger or smaller than the integer bounds.

tests.name: test_negative_integers_float
tests.intent: Probes comparisons between negative integers and negative floats near mantissa thresholds.

tests.name: test_unsorted_container_sorting
tests.intent: Probes sorting a vector of json values containing mixed integers and floats that trigger boundary issues.

tests.name: test_zero_comparisons
tests.intent: Probes zero integer compared against various float representations of zero (positive and negative).

tests.name: test_float_inf_comparisons
tests.intent: Probes comparisons between integer values and infinity float values.

tests.name: test_subnormal_float_comparisons
tests.intent: Probes comparisons between integers and subnormal or near-zero floating-point numbers.

tests.name: test_strict_weak_ordering_checks
tests.intent: Probes equivalence relation properties (equiv(x,y) and equiv(y,z) implying equiv(x,z)) using negation of comparisons.

tests.name: test_mixed_type_std_map_keys
tests.intent: Probes using mixed types as keys in std::map where strict weak ordering is required.

tests.name: test_different_integer_width_boundaries
tests.intent: Probes floating point comparisons with standard 32-bit integers versus 64-bit integers.

tests.name: test_swapped_operand_order
tests.intent: Probes symmetry of operators when float is on the left-hand side and integer on the right-hand side.

tests.name: test_float_precision_small_fraction
tests.intent: Probes integers compared against floats differing by a tiny fraction within mantissa precision limits.

tests.name: test_unsigned_zero_comparisons
tests.intent: Probes unsigned zero against positive and negative floating-point numbers.

tests.name: test_multiple_comparison_operators_consistency
tests.intent: Probes consistency across all relational operators (<, <=, >, >=, ==, !=) for mixed integer/float boundaries.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise compare_integer_with_float when fraction < 0 by comparing a float that is slightly below an integer value within the safe integer range.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise number_integer vs number_float macro arm via operator== and operator!= where integer is left-hand side.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise number_float vs number_integer macro arm via operator< and operator<= where float is left-hand side.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise number_unsigned vs number_float macro arm via operator> and operator>= where unsigned integer is left-hand side.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise number_float vs number_unsigned macro arm via operator< and operator== where float is left-hand side and unsigned integer is right-hand side.
